source: FDIC BankFind Suite, failures and assistance transactions since 1934
license: US Government work, public domain (FDIC BankFind Suite API)
derived_by: prometheus.data_ingestion.fdic_banks (counted per calendar year of the failure date)

columns.failures: institutions that failed in the year (resolution type FAILURE)
columns.failed_assets: their total assets at failure, USD thousands
columns.failed_deposits: their deposits at failure, USD thousands
columns.assisted_assets: total assets of the assisted institutions, USD thousands

frequency: annual; the date is the year end
caveat: the 2008-2009 assistance rows include very large institutions (their assets are not losses); a failure's assets are not the loss to the insurance fund
